weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; shared BAS, contractor, and integrator accounts; 9-day delay removing a departed employee
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-005, R-008; P03 CPG 3.C, 3.D
remediation_plan: Departure checklist and monthly account review (POL-02 B.4, B.6); named accounts on the BAS workstation and for each contractor technician; integrator access only on request
milestones: 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 named BAS accounts and first monthly review; 2026-12-31 named contractor accounts in the remote access service
resources_required: Property Manager time (1 hour a month); controls contractor time

weakness: Platform administrator accounts, the contractor remote-desktop account, and the MSP backup console accept a password alone
remediation_plan: Turn on app-based MFA for every platform administrator and operator; MFA on the backup console; contractor access moves to the remote access service with MFA (POAM-003)
milestones: 2026-09-15 platform MFA on; 2026-09-30 backup console MFA with screenshot evidence from the MSP
resources_required: No cost (built-in features); MSP labor included in contract

weakness: Always-on contractor remote-desktop tool with a shared account; no approval, monitoring, strong authentication, or records
source: P07 (MA-04 objectives); P01 R-001; P03 CPG 1.E
remediation_plan: Remove the always-on tool; MSP remote access service with named contractor accounts, MFA, per-session approval by the Building Engineer, and session recording kept 90 days
milestones: 2026-09-30 contractor agrees in writing; 2026-10-15 service set up; 2026-10-31 old tool removed

weakness: No separation between office computers and building devices at Property A; Property B on an ISP router with default settings and UPnP on
remediation_plan: Building-device segment at each property with deny-by-default rules (SP 800-82 Rev. 3 zones); MSP-managed business router at Property B with UPnP off; quarterly external scan of both properties
milestones: 2026-08-12 Property B router password changed and UPnP turned off; 2026-11-30 Property B router replaced; 2026-12-31 Property A segment in place and tested

weakness: No inventory of building devices; BAS workstation missing from the MSP list
remediation_plan: One inventory of all IT and OT devices with location, serial number, and firmware; network diagram per property; review each quarter
resources_required: Building Engineer and Property Manager time; controls contractor (about 2 hours)

weakness: BAS workstation unpatched since March 2025 without approval; supervisory controller firmware never updated; no defined time limits
source: P07 test; P01 R-009; P03 CPG 2.B
remediation_plan: Written exception process (POL-02 A.10); monthly contractor-approved patching of the workstation with a tested rollback; 14-day limit for critical updates in the MSP contract; supervisory controller firmware review at the next service visit
milestones: 2026-09-30 exception recorded; 2026-10-31 first approved patch cycle; 2026-12-31 firmware reviewed and contract terms added

weakness: Backups not immutable, 30 days only, one MSP password; controller programs not backed up by the company
source: P07; P01 R-002; P04 finding 2; P03 CPG 3.O
remediation_plan: Immutable 90-day retention behind MFA (POAM-002); controls contractor delivers copies of all controller programs, kept in the backup after each change
milestones: 2026-09-30 controller program copies received; 2026-10-31 backup upgraded
resources_required: About $700 a year; controls contractor time

weakness: No contingency plan and no restore ever tested
remediation_plan: Restore the BAS workstation image to the spare laptop and a shared drive sample; quarterly tests recorded; contingency plan with manual procedures; tabletop using the P08 runbook
milestones: 2026-10-15 first restore test; 2026-11-30 tabletop; 2026-12-31 contingency plan and second restore test
resources_required: MSP labor (about 3 hours a quarter); spare laptop about $900

weakness: No security terms in contractor agreements; no oversight; MSP evidence (technician list, MFA on its platform) not received
remediation_plan: Security addendum (POL-02 A.5) for the MSP, controls contractor, security integrator, and janitorial contractor; yearly MSP security review; platform vendor SOC 2 review each year
milestones: 2026-08-20 platform vendor SOC 2 reviewed (P09); 2026-09-30 MSP evidence received; 2026-12-31 addenda signed
resources_required: Managing Member and Property Manager time; attorney review about $500

weakness: Credential list not approved, maintained, or reviewed; holders removed only when tenants ask
source: P07 (PE-02 objectives); P01 R-006; P03 CPG 3.D
remediation_plan: Quarterly tenant confirmation; automatic disable after 90 days unused; request form for every credential; departure-notice clause in renewed leases
milestones: 2026-08-07 38 unused credentials disabled; 2026-10-31 first quarterly confirmation and inactivity rule on
resources_required: Tenant Services and Leasing Coordinator time (2 hours a quarter)

weakness: Default passwords on the supervisory controller and Property B router; weak, shared, written-down BAS password; no password manager
source: P07 test 2026-08-11 (new finding); P01 R-022, R-024; P03 CPG 3.A, 3.B
remediation_plan: Change both defaults to unique passphrases in the password manager; password manager for all staff; remove the written password; commissioning checklist for new devices
milestones: 2026-08-12 Property B router password changed; 2026-09-15 supervisory controller password changed; 2026-10-31 password manager in use
resources_required: Password manager about $300 a year; controls contractor time

weakness: New-hire video only; no annual or privacy training, phishing exercises, or OT module
remediation_plan: Annual training with privacy and card-handling content; quarterly phishing simulations; OT module for the Building Engineer and Maintenance Technicians
milestones: 2026-10-31 first annual training; 2026-12-31 first simulation and OT module

remediation_plan: Monthly 30-minute review of platform administrator changes, suite sign-in alerts, and remote access sessions with a checklist; MSP log service with 1-year retention
milestones: 2026-10-31 first review; 2026-12-31 log service in place
resources_required: Property Manager time; MSP log service included in the EDR price
